subject: Invite: Ignite Summit — Lumina Health customer spotlight
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@lumina.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invite: Ignite Summit — Lumina Health customer spotlight

Hi Michael,

Hope you’re well — we really appreciate Lumina Health partnering with us on the pilot last quarter. Ignite (a healthcare AI conference we’re co-sponsoring) asked if Lumina would join a short customer-spotlight panel at their Summit (San Francisco, July 21).

Details we have so far:
- 10–12 minute customer spotlight + 20-minute panel (moderated)
- Hybrid option if travel’s not feasible
- Light honorarium + travel stipend for in-person speakers
- Promo includes company logo, short bio, and one slide of customer results

Would Lumina be willing to participate? If so, could you share a 2–3 sentence speaker bio and a headshot? I’ve attached a one-pager on the Summit and a short speaker-bio template to make this quick.

Next steps I propose:
1) If yes, schedule a 20-min prep call in early July
2) Confirm whether you’re speaking in-person or remotely
3) Share any internal approvals needed for logo/quote usage

CCing Marissa from our Customer Success team to help with any case-study material/metrics.

Thanks — appreciate you considering it.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-summit-one-pager.pdf (1 page), speaker_bio_template.docx (docx)

From: Michael Tan <michael.tan@lumina.health>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ignite Summit Program <program@ignite.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: Ignite Summit — Lumina Health customer spotlight

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the invite and congrats on the Summit programming. We’d love to talk more — Lumina is open to a customer spotlight in principle. A few quick questions before we commit:

- Can you confirm the slate of panelists / who’s moderating?
- What’s the honorarium amount and travel stipend policy?
- Will the session be recorded and shared publicly?

I’m tentatively available the week of July 19th but would prefer a hybrid participation (remote) unless travel is covered. I’ll confirm with our comms/legal if we can share the logo and a short quote.

Thanks,
Michael Tan
Director of Data & Analytics
Lumina Health
michael.tan@lumina.health

---Original Message---
On Mon, May 25, 2026 at 9:12 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Michael,
> 
> Hope you’re well — we really appreciate Lumina Health partnering with us on the pilot last quarter...

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@lumina.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: Ignite Summit — Lumina Health customer spotlight

Hi Michael — great questions, thanks for flagging them. Quick answers: 

- Moderator: Ignite has confirmed Dr. Aisha Rahman (healthcare AI editorial lead) — she’ll guide the panel and handle audience Q&A. I’ll send the full lineup once confirmed (expect 3 vendor+1 customer).
- Honorarium/stipend: $1,000 honorarium + up to $800 travel stipend if attending in person. If remote, $500 honorarium.
- Recording: yes, session will be recorded and shared on Ignite’s site and Redwood’s channels; we will send the recording to you for review before distribution.

We’re happy to take whatever form is easiest for Lumina (remote or in-person). Marissa — can you help collect a 2–3 sentence impact quote and one slide showing any high-level outcomes (latency/cost/uptime improvements) from our pilot? Rishi — FYI in case we want to pull a short product quote or ask for a quick metric confirmation.

If Michael is okay, can we schedule a 20-minute prep call the week of July 6–9? I’ll send a Doodle unless you prefer a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Attachments: redwood-summit-one-pager.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: Ignite Summit — Lumina Health customer spotlight

Stephanie / Rishi — I can reach out to Michael to draft the 2–3 sentence impact quote and pull a single slide of results. Two notes:

1) Legal typically wants to see the quote and slide before we publish — plan for a 48-hour review window.
2) We should aim to surface one specific metric (e.g., 30% cost reduction on inference pipelines) — product can confirm numbers.

I’ll ping Michael with a short template and deadline (June 12) unless you’d rather I wait until he confirms the session.

—Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Michael Tan <michael.tan@lumina.health>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: Ignite Summit — Lumina Health customer spotlight

Hi Stephanie / Marissa — thanks, we’re confirmed. Lumina will participate remotely. Attached is my speaker bio and headshot. I’ve also drafted a short impact quote below — feel free to edit for length.

"Working with Redwood Inference accelerated our model deployment velocity and reduced per-request inference cost by approximately 28%, allowing us to reallocate infra budget toward feature experimentation."

I’m happy to hop on a prep call July 7 (morning PT) — send an invite and I’ll confirm. Regarding legal/PR: I’m clearing the logo and quote with our comms team now and will loop them in if we need sign-off.

Attachments: speaker_bio_lumina_michael_tan.docx (docx), lumina_headshot_tan.jpg (image)

Best,
Michael Tan
Director, Data & Analytics
Lumina Health
